manifest.author: Sean Galliher and Cowork Cookbook contributors
manifest.description: Builds a Monday.com messaging and positioning board for a named product or campaign, grouped by section (value pillars, feature-to-benefit, persona cards, business alignment, competitive positioning), pre-filled from you
manifest.name: @cowork-cookbook/develop_messaging_and_positioning

details.license_note: Recipe content is CC BY 4.0 (share and adapt with attribution) and code is MIT. RAR carries each recipe's prompt, prerequisites, steps and expected output verbatim with attribution, so the toasted agent runs the real recipe; bundles and screenshots stay upstream.

audience.description: The target audience the messaging should be tailored to.

competitor_name.description: The competitor to differentiate against in the positioning statements.

context.description: Optional. Details the recipe should use — the record, scope, dates or filters it asks for.

operation.description: What to do: run, prompt, plan, checklist, describe.

product_or_campaign_name.description: The product or campaign the messaging and positioning is being developed for.

source_documents.description: Product Strategy doc, Customer Insights Report, Competitive Summary, and approved Brand Voice guidelines to pull from.
